integrity: The supplied verifier reconstructs P_19 from quadratic residues, verifies double regularity, enumerates all transitive faces, computes boundary ranks over five prime fields, checks all 171 affine automorphisms, and recomputes every signed Lefschetz trace using exact integer arithmetic.
scientific_limitations: The homotopy-type identification uses the published two-type classification of 19-vertex doubly regular tournaments and an exact Euler-characteristic distinction. The equivariant statement is for the explicit affine Paley subgroup of order 171; no integral lattice or equivariant homotopy classification is claimed.
title: Affine symmetry identifies the Paley-19 directed flag complex and its homology character
